profile.headline: Contract Software Engineer at EY
profile.summary:
Contract Software Engineer with 20 years experience in systems architecture, analysis, design and development using full life-cycle software development.  Expert in financial accounting systems with 11 years experience designing and developing various systems to handle amortization, valuation, impairment accounting, financial reporting and Tax accounting.        
Strong web and backend experience using enterprise technologies such as Python, J2EE, EJB, JMS, JSP, JDBC, Struts, JavaScript, Oracle, VB .Net, C++, ADO .Net, Neural Networks and Deep Learning.  U.S. citizen with six years of Naval submarine service in Nuclear Engineering and Electronics (Top-Secret clearance.)

Specialties: Accounting Systems Developement.  Web Application Developement.  Nuclear Engineering.  Electronics Engineering

positions.title: Financial Systems Software Engineer (Consultant)
positions.description:
Served as team lead/architect for the design and implementation of the SOP03-3 engine. The SOP03-3 engine provided accounting services for Fannie Mae’s non-performing loans portfolio.  The system handled Troubled Debt Restructure, Modification, Impairment, Fas114 and SOP03-3 accounting.  Also, served as software engineer for loan processing for restatement FAS91 amortization engine that was responsible for GAAP accounting of the Performing Loan and Mortgaged Backed Securities portfolio. The engine was hosted by weblogic in a clustered environment and processed over 200,000 security income/loss results per hour.  Involved in the design and implementation of the engine technology by providing the following:   

•	Wrote many business requirements for SOP03-3 accounting system.
•	Performed various business analysis tasks and manual materiality quantifications 
•	Served as team lead and architect for the design of the SOP03-3 amortization engine
•	Technical design and implementation of three major accounting systems within Fannie Mae
•	Performance enhancements 
•	Database tuning 
•	Implementation of JMS Topics and Queues
•	Implementation of Message Driven Beans
•	Implementation of EJBs that provided amortization services that could be consumed by remote components.
•	Used/implemented SPRING technology for data access layer, system configuration

Technical Components:  J2EE 1.3, EJB, JMS, MDB, SPRING, JDBC, ANT, Oracle 9i, Weblogic 8.3, VB .Net, ADO .Net

positions.title: Financial Systems Software Engineer (Consultant)
positions.description:
Software engineer for the Retained Portfolio’s Asset Amortization Engine project that which was part of the Freddie Mac re-statement effort. The Amortization Engine amortized fees in accordance with FAS91/92, EITF99-20 for PCs, CMO/REMIC, IO, PO’s, and ABS’.  The system integrated with the analytics prepayment model for all instruments using a combination of forward rate projections from the Chief Economist using LIBOR, Treasuries, and PMMS rates. The underlying engine technology utilized an adapter-based design using XML configuration files to hide underlying persistence details.  Analytics model was integrated via webMethods using SOAP as the protocol interface. 
•	Worked on technical design of the engine
•	Provided performance enhancements to the engine.
•	Designed/Created web-app that interfaced with the Amortization Engine.  This system allowed (for the first time) the user to amortized fees on the fly with varying fee parameters in order to create analytic scenarios.  The system generated graphical analytical results that were used by Investment Accounting to better understand how certain fee parameters affected amortization results within an isolated environment.
•	Used Castor to convert prepayment model information into xml soap requests.
•	Used Commons Digester in mapping xml to business objects.
•	Used apache AXIS as soap server/client for the amortization engine.
•	Involved in the Design/Implementation/Integration of the Amortization Engine to the EAGLE account system that replaced the legacy accounting infrastructure.
•	Involved in the Design/Implementation of Corporation Amortization Services.  This project adds Single Family Fees amortization capabilities to the existing Amortization Engine.

Technical Components:  J2EE 1.3, STRUTS 1.2, JSP, UML, Hibernate, JDBC, ANT 1.6.1, HTML, JavaScript, Apache Axis Soap, Castor, Commons Digester, Sybase, DB2, Weblogic 8.12, Tomcat 5.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer Consultant
positions.description:
Performed analysis, design, construction, deployment, and testing for the FAA web-based Air Traffic Quality Assurance (ATQA) application.  The initial version of the application had failed; our team was hired to rewrite the software.  
•	Involved in the architecture, analysis, and design of every major phase of development.
•	Provided council and advice to management on project direction and goals. 
•	Installed and configured application MVC framework to use the popular open source framework STRUTS.  Configured multiple STRUTS application modules.  
•	Implemented Server-Side validation using STRUTS validator 1.0.  Designed and configured validation for all aircraft incidences.  Designed and created various custom validators for use throughout the application. 
•	Used JavaScript/DHMTL to create client-side validations used in validating user input and in guiding user interaction.
•	Created build and deployment scripts using ANT 1.5.4 for application packaging and deployment.  
•	Installed and configured application logging using the popular open source logging tool LOG4J 1.2.8.
•	Performed analysis, design, and implementation of the applications search functionality using JDBC 2.0.  Designed and implemented a flexible report search API that dynamically creates complex SQL queries, which are used in locating various types of incident reports throughout the application.
•	Involved in the implementation of LDAP for use in the application security.
•	Performed analysis and design of applications data model.  Used Oracle SQL Plus to create ddl and dml scripts.
•	Used Hibernate 2.0 for object persistence layer.
•	Performed maintenance on PDF generation application module.  Used XSL-FO, Apache FOP Renderer.
•	Used Apache Commons Digester for object-xml mapping of the applications configuration data. 


Technical Components:  J2EE 1.3, STRUTS 1.1, JSP, Hibernate 2.0, ANT 1.5.4, HTML, JavaScript, XSL-FO, XML, JDBC, Oracle9i, Oracle9i AS.

positions.title: Lead Programmer/Architect
positions.description:
Lead programmer for the design, implementation, deployment, and documentation of the Eventviewer web application.  The Eventviewer web application provided the user interface to a Java-based event rating engine and also provided the user with the tools to control the rating process, analyze the rating results, create rating rules, etc.  Implemented several project critical modules, including Batch Rating, Processing, and Failed Event Reprocessing.  Created and implemented various custom-tailored client install packages for Weblogic and Tomcat.  Designed and implemented a graphical interface that was very well received by the client base.  

With an extremely shortened development schedule, and at the request of the client, was able to create the Batch Rating Module of the Eventviewer.  The client responded positively and acceptance of the module.

General responsibilities included overseeing system design and architecture, development, maintenance, management of the quality assurance process, documentation, and training.

Technical Components:  J2EE 1.3, JSP, JavaScript, XML, SOAP, JDBC, Oracle8i, VB6, COM, ADO, HTML.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Served as a key player of a team of four that performed complete life cycle development using rational unified processes to create and enterprise equipment maintenance benchmarking application.  The application was so well received that the client base more than doubled in a four-month period.

The application is an n-tier, component-based, distributed application that incorporates a plug-able channel paradigm to allow channels (software components) to attach to the main application on the fly.  The team created Active X controls for use with the application.

Also served as the designer/architect for the applications data migration tool.  This tool uses ADO to import maintenance information to the maintenance database (Oracle Lite) for later replication to the main database (Oracle 8) using a WIZARD type format.  Once the tool connects to the data it provides the user with an easy-to-use editing environment that resembles Excel.  It also validates the data and provides feedback to the user so that the data can be corrected before it is imported.  The application allows a user at a client site to replicate data to the server.

Technical Components:  Visual Studio 6.0, Rational Rose, Erwin, VB 6, COM, DCOM, ADO, Oracle 8, Oracle P/L, SQL, Oracle, Access, Excel.

positions.title: Payroll Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the development, maintenance, and testing of the ADP payroll application.  Worked with a team of six developers that performed system enhancements for ADP’s Canadian payroll and quarterly magnetic media reporting software in a full development, life-cycle. 

Developed and maintained automated testing programs used to ensure application quality and data integrity

positions.title: Nuclear Reactor Operator/Electronics Technician
positions.description: Responsible for the operation and maintenance of mission-critical reactor control systems and a variety of state-of-the-art electronics systems associated with nuclear propulsion on board a Los Angeles class fast-attack submarine.  Duties included:  supervising, training and evaluating junior technical personnel; performing preventive and corrective maintenance; determining priorities and assigning tasks; inspecting subordinates’ work; providing technical advice to supervisors; utilizing a variety of test equipment, technical publications, and schematic diagrams to test, inspect, remove, and repair faulty components.
